name: SimpleRelay
short_desc: Self-hosted SMTP relay with a web dashboard and per-client access control.
author: toinbox (hardened build)
description: SimpleRelay relays mail from your LAN devices and apps through your existing email providers (Gmail, etc.), with a web dashboard, DNS checks and an IP / SMTP-AUTH allow-list. This build is a hardened fork: registration is disabled, weak secrets are refused at startup, and provider hosts are validated.

form_fields.label: Admin email
form_fields.hint: Login for the dashboard. Created on first start only.

form_fields.label: Admin password
form_fields.hint: At least 12 characters. Used once to create the admin account; change it later in the dashboard.

form_fields.label: Relay hostname
form_fields.hint: Name or IP your devices use to reach the relay. Used for the SMTP greeting and DNS checks.

form_fields.label: Public IP (optional)
form_fields.hint: Only needed if you want the relay to identify itself with a public IP. Leave blank otherwise.

form_fields.label: Dashboard served over HTTPS?
form_fields.hint: Choose Yes only if you open the dashboard through an https:// address; the login cookie then refuses plain HTTP.

form_fields.label: Secret key
form_fields.hint: Signs logins and encrypts stored provider passwords. Back it up: if it changes, saved provider passwords must be re-entered.
